import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 70;
    static final int MAXN2 = 50;
    static final int LIMIT = 22;
    static long[][] C = new long[MAXN + 5][MAXN + 5];
    static int n, m, N, mid_point;
    static int[] g = new int[MAXN + 5];
    static List<Pair>[][][] partb = new ArrayList[MAXN2 + 5][MAXN2 + 5];
    static Map<Long, Long>[][] parta = new HashMap[MAXN2 + 5][MAXN2 + 5];
    static long answer = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long answer_count = 0;

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;

        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        precompute();
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        String s = br.readLine();
        N = (n + m) << 1;
        mid_point = Math.max(0, N - LIMIT);
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAXN2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= MAXN2; j++) {
                partb[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAXN2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= MAXN2; j++) {
                parta[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        processPartA();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (s.charAt(i) == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        processPartA();
        System.out.println(answer_count);
    }

    static void precompute() {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static void dfsPartb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, long sum) {
        if (x == mid_point) {
            partb[cnta][cntb].add(new Pair(sum, 1));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 1; i++) {
            if (g[x - 1] != -1 && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cnta > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfsPartb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntb > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfsPartb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void processPartA() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                parta[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m; j++) {
                Map<Long, Long> currentMap = parta[i][j];
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : new HashSet<>(currentMap.entrySet())) {
                    long uX = entry.getKey();
                    long uY = entry.getValue();
                    if (i + j == mid_point) {
                        int p = lowerBoundPartb(-uX, partb[i][j]);
                        if (p < partb[i][j].size()) {
                            long val = Math.abs(uX + partb[i][j].get(p).first);
                            update(val, uY * partb[i][j].get(p).second);
                        }
                        if (p > 0) {
                            long val = Math.abs(uX + partb[i][j].get(p - 1).first);
                            update(val, uY * partb[i][j].get(p - 1).second);
                        }
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k <= 1; k++) {
                            if (g[p] != -1 && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                            if (k == 0) cnta++;
                            else cntb++;
                            if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
                                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
                                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                }
                                long newKey = uX + tmp;
                                parta[cnta][cntb].put(newKey, parta[cnta][cntb].getOrDefault(newKey, 0L) + uY);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBoundPartb(long value, List<Pair> list) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).first >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (val < answer) {
            answer = val;
            answer_count = cnt;
        } else if (val == answer) {
            answer_count += cnt;
        }
    }
}
